sentences.en: It is absolutely necessary that you be at the meeting.
sentences.zh: 你必须准时参加这个会议。

sentences.en: The chairman put forward an important plan at the meeting.
sentences.zh: 主席在会议上提出了一个重要的计划。

sentences.en: She attended the meeting at the request of the chairman.
sentences.zh: 她应主席的要求参加了这次会议。

senses.zh: 相遇( meet的现在分词)；相识；开会
